newsitem.title: USA: Washington Trust to split stock, raise div.
newsitem.headline: Washington Trust to split stock, raise div.

text.p: Washington Trust Bancorp Inc said Thursday it set a three-for-two stock split and increased its quarterly dividend on a pre-split basis to $0.27 a share, up from $0.26.
The effective post-split quarterly dividend rate would be $0.18 per share. It is to be awarded to shareholders of record on October 1 and paid out on October 15.
The stock split will also apply to shareholders of record on October 1. The company said it would distribute one additional share for every two shares held.
The additional stock certificates are to be mailed October 15. The company will make cash payments in lieu of fractional shares.

Washington Trust Bancorp Inc is the parent company of The Washington Trust Co, which operates six branches in southern Rhode Island. The bank plans to open a seventh branch in the state later this year.
